register_eigen_printers: register Eigen pretty-printers with the GDB objfile so Matrix and Array types display nicely in the debugger
build_eigen_dictionary: build the pretty printers dictionary mapping regex patterns for Eigen Matrix, Array, and Quaternion to their printer classes
lookup_function: look up and return the appropriate pretty-printer for a given GDB value by matching its type name
EigenMatrixPrinter: create an EigenMatrixPrinter instance to pretty-print Eigen Matrix or Array values with row and column iteration support
EigenQuaternionPrinter: create an EigenQuaternionPrinter instance to pretty-print Eigen Quaternion values with x, y, z, w component iteration
